title: Nice Concept, but Manufacturing Flaw Spoiled the Party
text:
Nice Concept, but Manufacturing Flaw Spoiled the Party. Bars are useful when you like to entertain. I have a large backyard with a pool and spa and when we invite people over, we often need more ways to serve guests. This is when a portable bar can come in handy and this occasional need convinced me to add the 2L Lifestyle Southwood Folding Wine Cabinet Bar to our home.

With this portable bar, you get a pressed wood structure with a black finish. It features a drawer, shelf space, and a cubby hole with 9 small sections for storing bottles and other durables. It has three slots designed to hold wine glasses in a hanging fashion so they are there when you need them. The two side panels fold in and the flaps on the top fold down, making it possible to store this bar in a small space.

Everything about this portable folding wine cabinet sounds good, but there is one issue I had that forces me to lower my rating, and that is a design flaw that is going to take effort to fix. The problem is with the hinge on the right panel. It has an upper and lower stem that have to be placed into the hinges on the main cabinet and while this should be simple, the right panel has the stems facing up, not down like they should be. The left panel was manufactured properly, with the stem facing down and it fits perfectly fine. You cannot easily remove the hinges and turn them around because, while they are screwed into place, they are also apparently glued into place. It would require stripping them off, which will likely pull off the finish. And even then, if you turn the hinge around and re- fasten, it will require placing it just right so that the top of the bar fits into place.

I called the manufacturer to get a replacement piece but none are available because this product is no longer made! Lovely- now I have to decide whether I want to fix it myself, which may or may not work, or send it back in. I’m not happy with the situation, but at the same time, I did like the good customer service I received. The person on the phone tried everything to come up with a solution and I even sent him a picture so he could see what was wrong, and he admitted that this is, indeed, a manufacturing flaw. I also like how everything in the package was properly labeled. They even placed the hardware in separate, plastic bags with labels on each. This is much better than past experiences with similar products, many of which had all of the hardware mixed together in a single bag.

Portable bars are nice for those of us who entertain. The 2L Lifestyle Southwood Folding Wine Cabinet looks like a nice enough product and it would have worked out well for my home had it not been for the design flaw described above. Still, this is not something I can overlook so my advice is to purchase this at your own risk. You may get a perfectly designed product, ready to assemble and start using, or you may get a product with an obvious flaw, like I did. My experience convinces me to cut my rating to 1 or 2 stars, but I will go with 2, since the customer service rep went out of his way to try to correct the situation.
